1.web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
1.asv: I will cry unto God with my voice, Even unto God with my voice; and he will give ear unto me.

2.web: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
2.asv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: My hand was stretched out in the night, and slacked not; My soul refused to be comforted.

3.web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
3.asv: I remember God, and am disquieted: I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. [Selah

4.web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
4.asv: Thou holdest mine eyes watching: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

5.web: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
5.asv: I have considered the days of old, The years of ancient times.

6.web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
6.asv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search.

7.web: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
7.asv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will he be favorable no more?

8.web: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
8.asv: Is his lovingkindness clean gone for ever? Doth his promise fail for evermore?

9.web: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
9.asv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? [Selah

10.web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
10.asv: And I said, This is my infirmity; But I will rememberthe years of the right hand of the Most High.

11.web: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
11.asv: I will make mention of the deeds of Jehovah; For I will remember thy wonders of old.

12.web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
12.asv: I will meditate also upon all thy work, And muse on thy doings.

13.web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
13.asv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: Who is a great god like unto God?

14.web: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
14.asv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: Thou hast made known thy strength among the peoples.

15.web: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
15.asv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. [Selah

16.web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
16.asv: The waters saw thee, O God; The waters saw thee, they were afraid: The depths also trembled.

17.web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
17.asv: The clouds poured out water; The skies sent out a sound: Thine arrows also went abroad.

18.web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
18.asv: The voice of thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lightened the world: The earth trembled and shook.

19.web: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
19.asv: Thy way was in the sea, And thy paths in the great waters, And thy footsteps were not known.

20.web: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
20.asv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
